options.tooltip: OData protocol version. `auto` detects from `$metadata` (recommended); `v2` for legacy SAP services, `v4` for modern SAP services.

Path to the OData service, appended to Base URL. Select from catalog or enter manually. Example: `sap/opu/odata/sap/API_BUSINESS_PARTNER` (V2) or `sap/opu/odata4/sap/api_fixedassetacquisition/srvd_a2x/sap/fixedassetacquisition/0001` (V4).
OData entity set to extract data from (like a database table). Select from the list or enter manually. Examples: `A_BusinessPartner`, `SalesOrderSet`, `ProductSet`.
Configure field selection, filters, expansion, and ordering.
Specific fields to extract (`$select`). Leave empty to extract all fields. Reduces data transfer and API costs. [OData $select docs](https://www.odata.org/getting-started/basic-tutorial/#select)

Filter records using OData `$filter` syntax. Examples: `Status eq 'Active'`, `CreatedAt gt 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z`, `Price le 100 and Category eq 'Electronics'`. [OData $filter docs](https://www.odata.org/getting-started/basic-tutorial/#filter)

Related entities to include in the response (`$expand`). Examples: `Addresses`, `Items`, `Category`. Expanded data is flattened into columns. [OData $expand docs](https://www.odata.org/getting-started/basic-tutorial/#expand)
Configure how data is fetched from SAP OData API.

Full: extract all records on every run. Incremental: extract only new/changed records since the last run using a timestamp field filter. [OData filter docs](https://www.odata.org/getting-started/basic-tutorial/#filter)
Timestamp field used to filter new/changed records (`$filter={field} gt {last_run}`). Common SAP fields: `LastChangedAt`, `ModifiedOn`, `CreatedAt`, `SystemModstamp`.
Configure output table and how data is loaded to Keboola Storage.
Custom name for the output table in Keboola Storage. Defaults to the entity set name if left empty. Example: `business_partners`, `sales_orders`.

Full Load: replace the entire table on each run. Incremental Load: append/upsert new data using the primary key — requires a primary key for deduplication. [Keboola incremental loading docs](https://help.keboola.com/storage/tables/#incremental-loading)

Field(s) that uniquely identify each record — required for Incremental Load (used for upsert). Common SAP keys: `BusinessPartnerID`, `SalesOrderID`, `ProductID`. [Keboola primary keys docs](https://help.keboola.com/storage/tables/#primary-keys)
Override pagination settings for this entity. Leave empty to use global defaults.
Override the global default page size for this entity. Leave empty to use the global default.
Override the global max records limit for this entity (0 = unlimited). Leave empty to use the global default.
